name: @ai-gateway/gateway-server
description: Deployable HTTP/streaming AI Gateway server — the EM-5 composition root wiring every platform package into a running v1.0 MVP. Since EM-5.5, the platform-package wiring itself (bootstrap()/GatewayApp) and the HTTP layer (router/handlers/parsing/validation/response-shaping) live in @ai-gateway/gateway-runtime, shared with apps/vercel-adapter; this app owns only its own env-var loading and its own createServer()/.listen()/signal-handling lifecycle.
